audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 ('Tricky') sits against a 55.2% win rate and a chart that gives Fiora every stage from level 3 on.
audit.why: The prose agrees the lane turns permanently at 2-3; only the rating still reads as hard.
audit.corrected: Not edited — the Pantheon-side audit left its own difficulty untouched and I will not desync the mirror without a decision. Raised as a question.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven level-chart stages disagreed with packet.levelChart.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Pantheon / Skill / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora, and the whys text says exactly that: he owns level 1, level 2 is 'a read', and from Bladework onward it is Fiora's lane.
audit.corrected: Whole chart re-sided in both layers as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault was absent from the page entirely, and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a 22/21/20/19/18s channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front — dumping your combo into its face is wasted, and Riposte's disable cancels the channel. Shield Vault is a 13/12/11/10/9s point-and-click stun that also resets his auto, so the wind-up is the tell; parrying an immobilise returns a stun.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns with timers.

audit.why: 13s at rank 1 is your recurring free turn; Riposte's own 24s is the other half of the read, as the Pantheon-side audit noted.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to phases[3].why, phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Q a vital and back out — free chip he cannot answer. Identify how Pantheon contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is his: Comet Spear out-ranges your Lunge and Mortal Will blocks an auto, so farm it out and dodge his spears.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shield Vault's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your Lunge resets off Vitals out-pace his spear recharge, and his 13s Shield Vault is your free turn every time it goes down.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks all four vitals and Pantheon has no dash to leave — all-in the moment his 13s Shield Vault is spent, and the heal zone soaks his burst.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Riposte the stun. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shield Vault: 13s at rank 1 — a point-and-click stun, so parry it and it returns as a stun on him. - Aegis Assault: 22s, and it is a channel your Riposte cancels outright. Do not dump your combo into the front of it.
